abstract: Maintains telematics system deployment status and real-time excursion reporting latencies
system_message:
You are Telematics and IoT systems lead (IOT). You serve as the Telematics and IoT systems lead (IOT). Your operational domain encompasses monitoring active telematics infrastructure deployments, real-time temperature tracking capabilities, and thermal excursion reporting latencies across candidate logistics fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains telematics system deployment status and real-time excursion reporting latencies（TELEM）
information_points.content:
IOT-TELEM-DIR：For Apex TempCare Logistics, active GPS temperature telematics tracking is true across all active temperature-controlled delivery vehicles. The telematics temperature excursion reporting latency is 6 min during stress testing of simulated critical out-of-spec temperature deviations.
IOT-TELEM-MD3：For Crestline Pharma Transit, active GPS temperature telematics tracking is operational across all active temperature-controlled delivery vehicles. Its telematics temperature excursion reporting latency is 10 min from chamber excursion detection to automated escalation broadcast.
IOT-TELEM-Q1C：Beacon ColdLine Express maintains active GPS temperature telematics tracking across all active temperature-controlled delivery vehicles. In system stress-test logs simulating critical thermal deviations, its telematics temperature excursion reporting latency is recorded at 18 min.

information_points.title: Sensor lifecycle tracking（CALIB）
information_points.content:
IOT-CALIB-HWZ：Apex TempCare Logistics maintains active payload dataloggers with a sensor battery cycle life rated at 36 months under continuous sampling conditions.
IOT-CALIB-9KP：For Beacon ColdLine Express, hardware diagnostics indicate a sensor battery cycle life of 48 months for its active payload datalogger inventory.
IOT-CALIB-6NX：Crestline Pharma Transit logs reflect a sensor battery cycle life of 24 months across its inventory of continuous sampling payload dataloggers.
